Render: Get up to $100K in startup credits [...] As the founder of Surge team, seeing this product evolve to where it is today is genuinely emotional. Seeing it launch on PH today brings back a lot — the late nights, the messy whiteboards, the endless iterations, and the whole team pushing together to make it real. I'm no longer with the team, but I'm truly so proud of the Surge team — going from the v1 to here is a beautiful arc 👏

SurgePix tackles the exact pain I felt when building v1: generating with AI is fun, but editing is painful. Now you can edit every layer, repaint regions, swap text while staying on-brand, and even call agent skills from Claude Code / Cursor to generate visuals — this direction is spot on 🔥

Everyone, go try it and share your feedback !!!

Maker [...] So we built SurgePix around three ideas:

 Edit, don't regenerate: brush over any area to repaint it, split a flat image into editable layers, or pull the text off an image to retype it
 Upload your brand assets once, and every output stays on-brand
 For developers: SurgePix ships as open-source agent skills, so Claude Code, Cursor, or any AI agent can generate and edit visuals for you — right from your terminal, no browser needed

We're still early and shipping fast. Would love to hear what you think, and what you'd want SurgePix to do next.

Surge is a network toolbox for power users and a high-performance HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy server. It is capable of intercepting and logging the summary of network traffics, and meanwhile transmitting the traffic to other proxy servers according to the flexible rule system. Multiple proxy protocols are supported including HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, SOCK5 over TLS.
